en: Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a mosque. The image focuses on an ornate mihrab niche framed by arches and intricate Islamic geometric and floral patterns. Tall candlestick-like stands or lamp holders flank the scene. At the bottom there is printed caption text in French identifying the location as Sidi-Bou-Medine and describing the interior of the mosque and its mihrab.
